world.title: Flavio Bolsonaro Flees To US After Losing Brazil Election
world.summary: Flavio Bolsonaro, the defeated right-wing presidential candidate and son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, has reportedly fled to the United States after losing the election. This departure occurred despite a court order prohibiting him from leaving Brazil. US media outlets, including CNN and the Washington Post, confirmed his arrival late Tuesday, although his exact landing location remains undisclosed.

world.title: 'You Understand Who You're Dealing With?': Cuba Minister, US Envoy Trade Barbs In Fiery UN Clash
world.summary: A heated exchange between US and Cuban representatives interrupted a UN General Assembly debate regarding the US embargo on Cuba. The confrontation escalated into a shouting match, leading to a suspension of the discussion. The incident highlighted ongoing tensions between the two nations, with both sides trading barbs and emphasizing their differing perspectives on the embargo's impact.

world.title: Flavio Bolsonaro flees Brazil after Lula defeat, US offers visas to family
world.summary: Brazilian senator Flavio Bolsonaro has left Brazil for the United States following his defeat in the presidential election to incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva. He is currently in Miami with his family. In response to the situation, the US government has offered visas to Bolsonaro's family, facilitating their stay in the country after the electoral loss.

business.title: Stock Market Today: All You Need To Know Going Into Trade On Oct 28
business.summary: On October 28, Indian stock market indices Sensex and Nifty 50 concluded a volatile trading session with little change. Key stocks were highlighted, along with significant brokerage recommendations and a comprehensive trade setup. Market participants are advised to stay informed about ongoing developments and trends that may impact trading decisions as they prepare for the day ahead.

business.title: Japan's GMO urges customers to shut down PCs amid ransomware threat
business.summary: The GMO Group has advised customers to disconnect from the internet and shut down their computers due to a ransomware threat. A threat actor breached the company's Onamae Desktop Cloud and warned of an impending attack. The company confirmed the breach and is urging immediate action to protect customer data and systems from potential ransomware infiltration.

business.title: Gold rises above $4,050 ahead of Fed rate decision
business.summary: Gold prices rose to approximately $4,065 during the early Asian session on Wednesday, supported by declining oil prices. Market participants are closely monitoring the Federal Reserve's policy meeting scheduled for later that day, seeking insights into the future direction of U.S. interest rates. The outcome of this meeting could significantly influence gold market dynamics moving forward.

technology.title: Restriction Toggle, Letting China
technology.summary: Apple released iOS 27.2 on October 27, introducing a new feature for China-market users. The update includes a "Restrict Motion Data" option found under Settings—Privacy & Security—Motion & Fitness. This feature allows users to manage their motion data settings more effectively, reflecting Apple's ongoing adjustments to comply with local regulations and user privacy preferences in China.

technology.title: GTA 6's rumored file size ahead of November 19 launch sparks comparisons with previous editions
technology.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 is set to launch on November 19, with preloading available from November 12. The game, the first mainline entry in nearly 13 years, has generated buzz regarding its rumored file size, prompting comparisons with previous editions. As the release date approaches, anticipation continues to build among fans eager to experience the new installment.

technology.title: GTA VI May Require 210 GB of Storage on PlayStation 5
technology.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI may require 210 GB of storage on PlayStation 5, as reported by PlayStation Game Size. Preloading for the game is expected to begin on November 12, leading up to its official release on November 19. This size would make it one of the largest modern games in terms of download requirements.

sports.title: "A very sad day": Arteta speaks after Arsenal's resounding collapse
sports.summary: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta expressed disappointment following his team's unexpected exit from the Carabao Cup, losing to Fleetwood Town, a fourth-tier club. The match concluded with a penalty shootout, which determined the outcome in favor of Fleetwood. Arteta characterized the day as "very sad," reflecting on the significance of the defeat for the club and its supporters.

sports.title: Mikel Arteta facing fierce criticism as Arsenal boss hints at what he told Max Dowman
sports.summary: Mikel Arteta faced criticism following Arsenal's exit from the Carabao Cup after Max Dowman received a red card during the match against Fleetwood. Arteta expressed a desire to review the incident, highlighting the contentious nature of the decision. The team's performance and Dowman's dismissal have sparked discussions regarding the management's response and the implications for the squad moving forward.

health.title: Early detection vital in fight against breast cancer: Experts
health.summary: KMC held a state-level conference, “Holistic Approach to Breast Cancer,” highlighting the importance of early detection, timely medical intervention, and strong family support in fighting breast cancer. Medical experts stressed the need for increased public awareness to address the rising health challenge among women globally. The conference aimed to educate and promote proactive measures against breast cancer.

health.title: Early breast cancer: How to make space for treatment without losing sight of yourself
health.summary: Breast cancer treatment impacts various aspects of a woman's life, including daily routines, relationships, and emotional health. It is essential to understand treatment options, manage side effects, and seek appropriate support to maintain quality of life during this challenging journey. Balancing medical care with personal responsibilities can help women navigate their experiences without losing sight of themselves.

science.title: Scientists discover 237-million-year-old fully marine amphibian
science.summary: Scientists have discovered a 237-million-year-old fully marine amphibian, characterized by its body armor, which allowed it to thrive in seawater. This finding challenges previous beliefs, as amphibians typically rely on permeable skin for breathing and drinking, a trait that is less effective in saltwater environments. This discovery marks a significant addition to the understanding of amphibian evolution.

science.title: US-Based Startup Faces Backlash For Testing Nighttime Sunlight: "Idiotic Project"
science.summary: Reflect Orbital, a US-based startup, faces criticism after testing nighttime sunlight in a rural California area. Residents reported seeing a bright light from nearby mountains, leading to backlash against the project. The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) approved the startup's proposal in July to launch a demonstration satellite next year, aiming to showcase innovative lighting technology.
